propositions: Under a non-editable/wheel install, reconciler_repo_root() returns <venv>/lib/pythonX (the site-packages parent) as the repo root when REBAR_ROOT is unset, rather than a real checkout with .git and src/rebar, causing silent reconciliation of the wrong tree.

The package-location fallback Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] correctly resolves the checkout only under an editable install where the package physically resides inside the checkout; under a wheel install the package lives in site-packages.

The reconciler's default repo-root derivation must be CWD-independent and validated as a real checkout, enforcing the design invariant that a daemon launched from anywhere must operate on the correct repository tree.

Two sibling sites in fetcher.py (lines 507 and 626) bypass the owned reconciler_repo_root() resolver and re-derive repo-root directly from Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4], replicating the same non-editable defect.

Option C implements a layered validated fallback: REBAR_ROOT env (verbatim) → package root (if _is_repo_checkout) → git toplevel of CWD (if _is_repo_checkout) → raise clear error naming both REBAR_ROOT and --repo-root, never silently returning a non-checkout path.

A class-level guard (check_repo_root_from_package.py) must fail CI if any reconciler module reintroduces the raw Path(__file__).parents[N] package-location repo-root fallback, ensuring the construct defect is structurally drained.
